publicSpaces.name: Lumphini Park
publicSpaces.adaptation: Wireless school-side parking represented; interior paths pedestrian-only. Affine park compression preserves sourced lake topology, not exact distances.

publicSpaces.name: Sanam Luang
publicSpaces.adaptation: Perimeter drop-off only; ceremonial lawn/pedestrian paths are not public vehicle roads.

publicSpaces.name: Benjakitti Forest and Lake Park
publicSpaces.adaptation: Original east lake and three west wetland/islet fields based on Turenscape/Arsomsilp project plan. Width and southern convention-centre spacing compressed. Pedestrian skywalk/boardwalks have no road nodes; vehicle stops stay on Ratchadaphisek.

publicSpaces.name: Benchasiri Park
publicSpaces.adaptation: Compact sculpture garden south of Sukhumvit, west of Emporium and east of EmSphere. Pond and perimeter paths interpreted; no vehicles inside the park.

publicSpaces.name: Chatuchak Park
publicSpaces.adaptation: Long north-south lake and shaded walking circuits east of Mo Chit, northeast of Weekend Market. Queen Sirikit/Rot Fai parks and northern interchange complex deferred.
